topic: Someone finds a time capsule they don't remember burying
text: Paw against cold earth, the ground hard under leaves. I dig, I dig, not knowing why. The earth gives up its secrets, a hard shape beneath the roots of forgotten things. I scrape at it, my heart pounding in my chest, a rhythm of survival. This thing, it should not be here. It is not of the forest, not of the sky, not of the scents I follow. My breath comes in sharp pulls, my eyes wide on the darkness. I back away, the thing left half-buried, a monument to the unknown. The forest whispers, and I run, my feet light but frantic, the night air sharp and biting.
